description:
Finding: provider clients and tests grew large after the connector surface expansion. GitHub client is about 1.8k LOC and Slack client is about 1.2k LOC, with very large provider test files.

Scope:
- Split GitHub client by API area behind a stable facade: Issues, PullRequests, Repositories, Actions, Releases, Contents/Search/Installations as appropriate.
- Split Slack client by API area behind a stable facade: Conversations, Messages, Files, Reactions, Pins, Users, Search/Auth as appropriate.
- Split large provider tests along the same resource boundaries.
- Avoid behavior changes; this is an organization/refactor issue.

Primary files:
- apps/jido_connect_github/lib/jido_connect/github/client.ex
- apps/jido_connect_slack/lib/jido_connect/slack/client.ex
- apps/jido_connect_github/test/jido_connect_github_test.exs
- apps/jido_connect_slack/test/jido_connect_slack_test.exs
- apps/jido_connect_github/test/jido_connect/github/client_test.exs
- apps/jido_connect_slack/test/jido_connect/slack/client_test.exs

Acceptance:
- Existing public client functions remain callable or have deliberate compatibility shims.
- No single provider client module remains the dumping ground for all endpoint logic.
- Tests are split enough that future Beadwork issues touch focused files.
- mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test pass.
title: Refactor large provider clients and tests by API area
